exposure: maternal mental health problems during pregnancy
cohort: 4862 mothers participating in the Longitudinal Study of Australian Children
finding: Diabetes medication use and maternal mental health problems during pregnancy were associated with increased odds of caesarean section, while younger maternal age, having two or more children, and fathers having an unskilled occupation were associated with reduced odds of caesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found that young maternal age and having two or more children were associated with reduced odds of cesarean delivery.
